data.claim: The retry path is not unbounded: _retry_truncated races through _race -> _bounded (cut at min(timeout_s, total_budget_s - elapsed)); the stated '2132s elapsed' was total time since review start (first round ~1800s + retry round 332s) shown beside a per-request bound, i.e. a misleading line, already fixed by round_started in 0d99adf99 which landed after the bug was filed
data.falsifier: A retry request observed to outlive min(timeout_s, remaining) in a test, or a tick line without per-round time
data.mechanism: _race.attempt calls _bounded for every copy including retries; progress.tick printed time.time()-started only

chunk_findings.detail: The change only adds this test; the manifest lists no modification to `ddflow/services/review.py`. On the buggy code this test is meant to guard, the progress line for a retry still lacks the `, <n>s in this round` text, so `re.search(r"(\d+)s elapsed, (\d+)s in this round", ticks[0])` returns `None`, and line 32 calls `.groups()` on `None`, raising `AttributeError`. With the test's own scenario the test fails, and the actual bug remains unfixed.
